document.instructions:
# Repository Onboarding Instructions

## Onboarding Configuration Scope (this Run only)
This onboarding Run is authorized to modify ONLY the following onboarding configuration paths:
- .pharness/repository.yaml
- .pharness/instructions.md
- .pharness/project.yaml

No other paths may be edited during this onboarding Run.

## Future Development Scope (proposed, NOT authorized by this Run)
The candidate_contract.writable_paths field proposes the following scope for future development WorkItems, derived from discovered source, test, and documentation roots:
- src/ (source root)
- tests/ (test root)
- README.md (documentation)

Proposing these paths in the candidate contract does NOT authorize this onboarding Run to edit them. Future WorkItems will be evaluated separately against this proposed scope.

The .pharness/ paths are onboarding-only and are explicitly EXCLUDED from the future development scope. The requirements.lock dependency lock is immutable and is also excluded from writable_paths.

## Environment
- Profile: python-3.11 (runtime_kind: python, preparation_strategy: python_hashed_requirements)
- Network: denied
- Package installation: preparation_only (lifecycle scripts are denied)
- Dependency lock generation: disabled (lock is immutable)

## Acceptance
The acceptance command for this repository is:
- `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v`

## Services
No services are requested for this onboarding (requested_service_keys is empty). The product model includes svc_finance_web but it is not bound to this onboarding.

## Contract Status
No prior repository contract exists (alias_present: false, canonical_present: false). This proposal establishes the initial contract.
